text: This report recommends the award of the Request for Proposal (RFP-12) for the Electrical Infrastructure Improvements for the Lantern Festival Project.

The Board of Management of Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, or their designate to negotiate and execute a Construction Agreement with a qualified construction firm for Request for Proposals (RFP-12) for the Electrical Infrastructure Improvements for the Lantern Festival project at a purchase price as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 15, 2026) from the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, Toronto Zoo, and revised in the closed session. 2. Authorized the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 15, 2026) from the Director, Capital Program and Sustainability, Toronto Zoo, as revised in the closed session, following the closing of any purchase transaction.
